question: What did four local evaluation runs and one read-only audit show about using the design kit as one entry point for a Director, maker or builder and critic team, and what must change before the complete kit is published?
method: Four evaluation runs on synthetic briefs on 2026-11-13 across two local agent hosts: a React operations screen and campaign graphics with live DesignMD, Mobbin and 21st retrieval; a UI SDK build from saved retrievals; six offline Director routing cases; and a CMS Director to Visual Maker still production. A read-only audit the same day compared the unpublished local bundle with the published two-file skill, checked each named provider route, and read the run records. No client material is recorded.
queries: Local evaluation run records and friction logs for the design kit
Diff of the local bundle against the published skill
Launcher and configuration check for each provider the skill names
findings: In the CMS run the maker read three required kit files only after production and on host request, and the Director proposed a crop before inspecting pixels; reads were instructed as relevant, not listed.
Three files each defined the design pack differently and only one required the kit digest.
The v0 launcher on the evaluation host called itself and v0 was never exercised in any run; Figma and front-end checklist servers were configured on neither host.
The local bundle carried one operator's defaults, an absolute path and host-specific observations stated as general fact.
Independent reviewers rated every first pass as needing revision and repairs improved them; all briefs were synthetic, so no run shows quality on real work.
A light DesignMD read returned a 429 during the audit.
The complete bundle removed concrete contrast and target-size numbers the published version had.
adopted: A required-reads table in the entry file, a read list and kit digest at the top of every design pack, and a producer hold when either is missing or differs.
One design pack definition in the project record, referenced by the UI SDK and CMS references.
Director, maker or builder and critic roles, UI SDK, CMS, production, project record and evaluation references from the local bundle.
A required-reads check in the evaluation reference.
Contrast and pointer target numbers restored; a rule against colored edge bars.
Client material goes to a provider only when the assignment covers it and never to a generative provider by default, keeping the published version's limit.
rejected: Keeping v0, Figma and front-end checklist routes that no host could run.
Operator names, host names, absolute paths and unexplained role codenames in the portable bundle.
skipped: A hook or script that enforces reads; the portable skill stays instructions only and hosts may add their own check.
open_questions: Whether the required-reads table holds on an uncorrected first pass; not yet rerun.

sources.title: Local evaluation records and audit notes for the design kit team workflow
findings: A maker read required kit files only after production in one run.
The v0 launcher recursed and no run exercised v0.
